title: Support detached and internally detached XAdES cosigning
notes: The signer requires a verified reference profile for detached and internally detached cosignatures.
Official AutoFirma fixtures establish the reference profiles, and the installed AutoFirma 1.9 CLI can generate matching synthetic inputs.
done_when: A sanitized AutoFirma reference signature and matching data verify both original and new signatures after cosigning.
result: Support detached and internally detached XAdES cosigning
evidence: AutoFirma 1.9 created four synthetic originals: an external reference, wrapped XML, wrapped base64, and a referenced XML sibling. xmlsec1 independently verified the original and new signature for all four. The regression suite tests shipping AutoScript entry points and refuses mismatched external data. pnpm check:ci passed 2418 tests.
